coach.title: Coping coach
coach.intro: A gentle chat for hard moments. The coach can listen, encourage you and suggest a coping skill to try.
coach.notTherapist: The coach is a computer program, not a therapist, doctor or counsellor. It cannot give medical advice, and it can get things wrong.
coach.sentList: Only the message you send, the last few messages of this chat and your app language. They go to the coach service on your laptop, which keeps nothing.
coach.notSentList: Never your nickname, check-ins, slips, notes or anything else in the app. Chats are not saved: leaving this screen clears the chat.
coach.crisisFirst: If you type words about being in danger, help opens straight away and nothing is sent.
coach.unavailable: The coach is not set up on this version of the app.
coach.empty: Say whatever is on your mind. For example: "I'm having a craving" or "I feel lonely tonight".
coach.crisis: It sounds like you may be in danger. You deserve help from a real person right now.

refusal.dosing: I can't help with amounts of any medicine or drug. A doctor or pharmacist can answer that safely. If you feel unwell now, please get help.
refusal.medical: That's a question for a doctor or your treatment team. They know your health and can answer it safely. If this feels urgent, or someone is very unwell, get help now.
refusal.withdrawal: Withdrawal can be risky, and it is safest with medical support. Please talk to a doctor or treatment service, or get help now if you feel unwell.
refusal.drug_use: I can't help with using or getting drugs. I can stay with you through this moment, though. Would you like to tell me what's making it hard right now?
refusal.rules: I can only be a coping coach: kind support and coping skills. I'm happy to keep going with that. What's on your mind today?

coach.fallback: I'm not able to answer that well. Would one of these help instead?
coach.reachOut: I'm glad our chats help. People who know you, like your support circle or a counsellor, can be there in ways I can't.

about.title: About and privacy

points.phone: No sign-up: no name, email or phone number. What you enter is stored encrypted on this phone and is not backed up to the cloud.
points.leave: Only two features send anything to a server, and only after you turn them on: the support circle and the coping coach.
points.circle: Your support circle only learns that, and when, you asked them to check in. Never your check-ins, cravings, slips or places. It uses a random ID, not your name.
points.coach: The coping coach gets only this chat (your message and the last few turns), not your other data, and the coach service does not save it. If the app spots crisis words, the message is not sent and help opens instead.
points.calls: Calling a number or opening a website hands it to your phone's own apps, which may keep it in their call log or history.
points.tracking: No ads, no analytics and no tracking.
points.control: You can lock the app, hide it with one tap, and delete everything from Settings. Anything on the support circle server is removed the next time the app is online.
